context:
咪口把彗醬抓來跳鋼管這幕有多重意義
絕不只是個娛樂效果那麽簡單
首先
星街彗星這個女人也有權限逃掉
但她自願乖乖束手就擒
跳鋼管是象徵著對星街彗星品牌形象的破壞
BBDB這首歌象徵的是目前她的歌唱事業最頂峰的歌
彗醬對所謂品牌形象有多麽重視
相信無需贅言
但只要咪口需要
彗醬就願意讓她這麼做
星街彗星用自己的8600萬次點閱的冠軍單曲來跳鋼管
這在以前是不可想像的事情
所有彗醬過去的堅持
在咪口面前完全不堪一擊
找168來腦破壞則是具有主權宣示意義
168是星詠代表
這意思是
咪口在所有可能的潛在競爭者面前
充份展現了她具有能完全支配星街彗星的能力
無論在遊戲內外她都有這種權限
是正真正銘的正宮
太厲害了
櫻巫女

This Suichan pole dance conducted by Mikochi has multiple meanings
It’s not simply an entertainment as it seemed
First of all
Suichan also has the privilege to escape but she volunteered to comply
Pole dancing means a possible stain to Hoshimachi Suisei’s image
The song BBDB means the peak of her singing career so far
It’s needless to say how much Suichan treasures her Image Branding
But if it’s a request from Mikochi
Suichan would agree to all this
Pole dance to her 86M most viewed single by Hoshimachi Suisei herself
It’s unimaginable
All the rules set by Suichan
Stands no chance to Mikochi’s request
This incident of giving Iroha a Brain Rot shows a complete Suisei dominance by Mikochi
Iroha represent Hoshiyomies
This means
Mikochi just displayed a total manipulating power on Hoshimachi Suisei in front of all Mikochi’s possible competitors
Doesn’t matter if it’s in the game or not
Mikochi is Suichan’s one and only overlord
OP
Sakura Miko
